explore.description: Author, browse, and deliver your business concept schemes.

define.description: Author, generate, or import your business concept schemes.

deliver.description: Write governed metadata onto the mapped {{platform}} assets.

tags.name: Tags
tags.desc: Key/value governance tags on tables and columns. Drives discovery and access policy.
tags.notConfigured: Tag delivery is not configured. The uc_tag_sync job needs to be installed in Settings > Jobs to activate this.
tags.note: Tag delivery runs through the shared uc_tag_sync job, which also covers other aspects beyond semantic assignment. Configure its scope and schedule in Settings > Jobs.

desc.name: Column descriptions
desc.desc: Plain-language meaning on columns. What Genie and search read to answer accurately.

glossary.name: UC Glossary
glossary.desc: The governed business glossary in the platform itself.
glossary.note: Syncs concepts to Unity Catalog's native business glossary, the governed layer Genie Ontology reads from. Arrives at UC Glossary GA.

deliver.title: Deliver
deliver.tip: Deliver writes your governed metadata onto the platform. Downstream tools (Genie, search, agents) read it from there. Tags = policy & discovery. Descriptions = what Genie reads. Glossary = the governed business layer.
deliver.pendingSubtitle: Concept-to-asset links created since the last successful tag sync. A re-run of uc_tag_sync would deliver these.
deliver.comingSoon: Coming soon: configuring and running this sync from Ontos is not wired yet.

enrich.subtitle: Map your concepts to assets, then deliver governed metadata onto the platform.
enrich.platformTip: Delivery platforms come from your configured connections in Settings. Unity Catalog is the default. The delivery targets below adapt to the platform you pick.

map.title: Map
map.desc: Link a concept straight to a {{platform}} Asset (the default path, no product or contract needed), then optionally add links to data products and data contracts. All three are independent.
map.assetNote: Asset links are what Deliver enriches in step 2. Asset-direct linking works even before any product or contract exists, so it solves the chicken-and-egg case.
map.coverageTip: Coverage = share of a concept scheme's concepts with at least one link. Products and Contracts are optional extra links, so the three counts don't sum to the total. Only Assets can be enriched in step 2.
map.placeholderNote: Coverage figures are sample data — the live coverage service is unavailable right now.

review.title: Review suggested matches
review.subtitle: Accept or reject each concept-to-Asset match. Nothing syncs until you accept it.
review.applied: Applied {{count}} match(es). They will sync on next delivery.

modes.directDesc: Ontos applies changes to this workspace immediately via the service principal.
modes.indirectDesc: Ontos writes YAML to Git for your CI/CD pipeline to promote (dev to staging to prod).
modes.manualDesc: Ontos notifies a person to apply the change elsewhere.
modes.manageLink: Delivery mode is set per site in Settings, Delivery

mode.description: Advanced view reveals the ontology layer: RDF/SKOS, IRIs, property domain & range, and technical delivery settings. Simple hides them. Your choice is remembered.
mode.label: View mode
